article-an.title: Use an with The nasal patterns
article-an.bodyMarkdown:
Use **an** when the noun ends in a nasal vowel sound:

- **pen an** — the bread
- **chen an** — the dog
- **bonbon an** — the cracker

It also lists **an** with final syllables ending in **mi, mou, ni,** or **nou**, such as **chimi an**, **lanmou an**, and **jenou an**.

article-lan.title: Use lan with The nasal-plus-consonant pattern
article-lan.bodyMarkdown:
Use **lan** when the noun ends in a nasal vowel followed by a consonant:

- **lanp lan** — the lamp
- **chanm lan** — the room

You can also encounter uncommon endings such as **iy** or **uit** with this form.

article-nan.title: Use nan with The m, nn, èn, and òn patterns
article-nan.bodyMarkdown:
Use **nan** with nouns ending in **m** or **nn**, and also with endings such as **èn** or **òn**. Examples include:

- **marenn nan** — the godmother
- **fim nan** — the film
- **balèn nan** — the candle
- **zòn nan** — the area
- **lalin nan** — the moon

You may see **plim** paired with more than one article form, so this lesson does not use it for graded article choice.
